title: The Map's three most prominent pages after the illusionism hub still present the regress as the reply to illusionism: `concepts/consciousness` ("the seeming itself has experiential character ... Illusionism relocates rather than dissolves the explanatory gap"), `concepts/materialism` ("All illusions presuppose experience"), `topics/hard-problem-of-consciousness` ("seeming is itself experiential"); the hub says "the bare regress proves nothing"
